1	# Global Disease Burden Transition: 1990 vs 2024 DALY Comparison
     2	
     3	## Overview
     4	This collection of datasets captures the global epidemiological transition between 1990 and 2024, covering top causes of disability-adjusted life years (DALYs), disease burden composition by World Bank income group, and aggregate category totals.
     5	
     6	## Data Source
     7	
     8	### top10_daly_causes
     9	Contains 20 rows (10 per year). Fields: `year` (1990 or 2024), `rank` (1–10), `cause` (disease/condition name, string), `dalys_millions` (float, millions of DALYs), `category` (one of: Communicable, NCD, Injury). Represents the top 10 global DALY causes for each reference year.
    10	
    11	### daly_by_income_group
    12	Contains 8 rows (4 income groups × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `income_group` (Low income, Lower-middle income, Upper-middle income, High income), `communicable_pct`, `ncd_pct`, `injury_pct` — each a float summing to approximately 100% per row. Represents percentage share of total DALYs by disease category within each income group.
    13	
    14	### global_category_totals
    15	Contains 6 rows (3 categories × 2 years). Fields: `year`, `category` (Communicable, NCD, Injury), `dalys_millions` (float). Represents aggregate global DALYs by broad disease category.
    16	
    17	## Data Notes
    18	- DALY estimates are modeled based on GBD-style methodology; 2024 figures are projected estimates.
    19	- Communicable category includes maternal, neonatal, and nutritional conditions per GBD convention.
    20	- Percentages may not sum to exactly 100% due to rounding.

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Color scheme - editorial, publication-ready
COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#C44E52',  # Muted red
    'NCD': '#4C72B0',           # Muted blue
    'Injury': '#DD8452',        # Muted orange/amber
}

# Income group order
INCOME_ORDER = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
INCOME_SHORT = ['Low', 'Lower-middle', 'Upper-middle', 'High']

# Setup figure - 2x2 grid with bottom spanning
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 14))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

# Create grid
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1, 1.2], hspace=0.35, wspace=0.30)

ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])  # Global totals
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])  # Income group disparity
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])  # Top causes rank change

# ============================================
# PANEL 1: Global Category Totals 1990 vs 2024
# ============================================
global_data = data['global_category_totals']['data']

years = [1990, 2024]
categories = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']

# Organize data
vals_1990 = {}
vals_2024 = {}
for row in global_data:
    if row['year'] == 1990:
        vals_1990[row['category']] = row['dalys_millions']
    else:
        vals_2024[row['category']] = row['dalys_millions']

# Stacked bar chart
bar_width = 0.5
x_pos = [0, 1]

bottom_1990 = 0
bottom_2024 = 0
for cat in categories:
    v1990 = vals_1990[cat]
    v2024 = vals_2024[cat]
    ax1.bar(0, v1990, bar_width, bottom=bottom_1990, color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    ax1.bar(1, v2024, bar_width, bottom=bottom_2024, color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    
    # Labels inside bars
    ax1.text(0, bottom_1990 + v1990/2, f'{v1990:.1f}', ha='center', va='center',
             fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color='white')
    ax1.text(1, bottom_2024 + v2024/2, f'{v2024:.1f}', ha='center', va='center',
             fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', color='white')
    
    bottom_1990 += v1990
    bottom_2024 += v2024

# Total labels on top
ax1.text(0, bottom_1990 + 30, f'{bottom_1990:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom',
         fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')
ax1.text(1, bottom_2024 + 30, f'{bottom_2024:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom',
         fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

ax1.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1990', '2024'], fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('DALYs (millions)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Global Disease Burden by Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.set_xlim(-0.6, 1.6)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 2500)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
ax1.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)
ax1.set_axisbelow(True)

# ============================================
# PANEL 2: Income Group Disparity
# ============================================
income_data = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']

# Organize by year and income group
income_1990 = {}
income_2024 = {}
for row in income_data:
    ig = row['income_group']
    if row['year'] == 1990:
        income_1990[ig] = [row['communicable_pct'], row['ncd_pct'], row['injury_pct']]
    else:
        income_2024[ig] = [row['communicable_pct'], row['ncd_pct'], row['injury_pct']]

n_groups = 4
bar_width = 0.35
index = np.arange(n_groups)

# 1990 bars
bottom_1990 = np.zeros(n_groups)
for i, cat in enumerate(categories):
    vals = [income_1990[ig][i] for ig in INCOME_ORDER]
    ax2.bar(index - bar_width/2, vals, bar_width, bottom=bottom_1990,
            color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.85)
    bottom_1990 += vals

# 2024 bars
bottom_2024 = np.zeros(n_groups)
for i, cat in enumerate(categories):
    vals = [income_2024[ig][i] for ig in INCOME_ORDER]
    ax2.bar(index + bar_width/2, vals, bar_width, bottom=bottom_2024,
            color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=1.0)
    bottom_2024 += vals

ax2.set_xticks(index)
ax2.set_xticklabels(INCOME_SHORT, fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Share of total DALYs (%)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Disease Burden Composition by Income Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=10)
ax2.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)
ax2.set_axisbelow(True)

# Year labels
ax2.text(-0.35, 102, '1990', ha='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#666666')
ax2.text(0.35, 102, '2024', ha='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#666666')

# ============================================
# PANEL 3: Top 10 Causes Rank Change
# ============================================
top10_data = data['top10_daly_causes']['data']

causes_1990 = [(r['cause'], r['dalys_millions'], r['category']) for r in top10_data if r['year'] == 1990]
causes_2024 = [(r['cause'], r['dalys_millions'], r['category']) for r in top10_data if r['year'] == 2024]

# Get all unique causes
all_causes = set([c[0] for c in causes_1990] + [c[0] for c in causes_2024])

# Build mapping: cause -> (rank1990, rank2024, category, dalys1990, dalys2024)
cause_info = {}
for rank, (cause, dalys, cat) in enumerate(causes_1990, 1):
    cause_info[cause] = [rank, None, cat, dalys, None]
for rank, (cause, dalys, cat) in enumerate(causes_2024, 1):
    if cause in cause_info:
        cause_info[cause][1] = rank
        cause_info[cause][4] = dalys
    else:
        cause_info[cause] = [None, rank, cat, None, dalys]

# Sort by 2024 rank, then 1990 rank
sorted_causes = sorted(cause_info.items(), key=lambda x: (x[1][1] if x[1][1] is not None else 99,
                                                           x[1][0] if x[1][0] is not None else 99))

# Plot as a slope/bump chart
y_positions = np.arange(len(sorted_causes))

for i, (cause, info) in enumerate(sorted_causes):
    rank_1990, rank_2024, cat, dalys_1990, dalys_2024 = info
    color = COLORS[cat]
    
    # Left point (1990)
    if rank_1990 is not None:
        ax3.scatter(0, i, s=120, color=color, zorder=5, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5)
        ax3.text(-0.08, i, f'#{rank_1990}', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=color)
        ax3.text(-0.22, i, f'{dalys_1990:.1f}', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8, color='#555555')
    else:
        ax3.scatter(0, i, s=80, color='lightgray', zorder=5, marker='x')
        ax3.text(-0.08, i, '—', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9, color='gray')
    
    # Right point (2024)
    if rank_2024 is not None:
        ax3.scatter(1, i, s=120, color=color, zorder=5, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5)
        ax3.text(1.08, i, f'#{rank_2024}', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=color)
        ax3.text(1.22, i, f'{dalys_2024:.1f}', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8, color='#555555')
    else:
        ax3.scatter(1, i, s=80, color='lightgray', zorder=5, marker='x')
        ax3.text(1.08, i, '—', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, color='gray')
    
    # Connecting line
    if rank_1990 is not None and rank_2024 is not None:
        # Determine line style based on rank change
        if rank_1990 > rank_2024:
            ls = '-'  # Improved rank (lower number)
            lw = 2.0 if abs(rank_1990 - rank_2024) >= 3 else 1.5
        elif rank_1990 < rank_2024:
            ls = '-'
            lw = 2.0 if abs(rank_1990 - rank_2024) >= 3 else 1.5
        else:
            ls = '--'
            lw = 1.0
        
        ax3.plot([0, 1], [i, i], color=color, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls, alpha=0.7, zorder=3)
        
        # Rank change annotation for big shifts
        change = rank_1990 - rank_2024
        if abs(change) >= 3:
            mid_x = 0.5
            mid_y = i
            arrow = '↑' if change > 0 else '↓'
            ax3.annotate(f'{arrow}{abs(change)}', xy=(mid_x, mid_y), fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
                        ha='center', va='center', color=color,
